summary: Tests notification email delivery using the supplied SMTP settings or the settings already stored for the instance. Set `recipientEmail` to choose a recipient; when omitted, the authenticated user's email address is used.
Retrieves metadata for multiple links in one request. Supply the link URLs in `urls`; the response preserves the input order.
Retrieves metadata for a link. Provide the link's `url` to get its title, description, and image URL.
Retrieves multiple instance settings in a single request. Provide the resource names in `names`; the response returns the matching settings in the same order as the requested names.
Retrieves the instance profile and its basic deployment information. Use the profile to inspect the instance version, access mode, setup state, and any configured proof-of-humanity challenge.
Retrieves resource usage statistics for the instance. Access is restricted to administrators, so use an account with the `admin` role.
Exchanges the refresh token in the HttpOnly cookie for a new short-lived access token. Send the request with the refresh token cookie; the response includes the token's expiration time.

Terminates the authenticated user's session by revoking the refresh token and clearing the authentication cookie. Call this operation when the user signs out so the refresh token can no longer be used to obtain access tokens.

Authenticates a user with password credentials or an SSO provider. Supply the relevant credential object; password sign-in requires `username` and `password`, while SSO sign-in requires `idpName`, `code`, and `redirectUri`. The response includes an access token and sets a refresh-token cookie.
Retrieves information about the authenticated user by validating the access token. Use this endpoint to obtain the user's details, similar to an OIDC userinfo request.

Lists long-lived personal access tokens (PATs) for a user. Use `pageSize` and `pageToken` to retrieve results in pages; PATs provide API and script access and are distinct from short-lived JWTs used for session authentication.

Creates a long-lived personal access token for a user. Supply the required `parent` resource name in the format `users/{user}`; you can optionally provide a `description` and an `expiresInDays` value. The token value is returned only when you create the token, so store it securely at that time.
Lists the linked SSO identities for a user. Supply the user's identifier to retrieve the identities associated with that account.

Links an SSO identity to a user through an identity provider's OAuth flow. Provide the parent user, identity provider, authorization code, and redirect URI; include `codeVerifier` when the flow uses PKCE.
Lists pending space invitations for a user. Use `pageSize` to set the maximum number of invitations to return and `pageToken` to continue through the results. The invitations are for joining spaces.
Lists notifications for a user. Use `pageSize` to control the number of results and `pageToken` to continue through paginated results; optionally use `filter` to narrow the list.
Lists pending invitations for a space. Use `pageSize` to limit the number of invitations returned and `pageToken` to continue from a previous response.
Creates an invitation for an existing active user to join a space. Provide the invitee's user resource name in `invitee` and choose the role they will receive after accepting.
Lists attachments associated with a specific memo. Use `pageSize` to limit the number of results and `pageToken` to continue through the results.

Replaces the full set of attachments associated with a memo. Pass the complete desired list in `attachments`; an empty list clears the memo's attachments, and repeating the same request is idempotent.
Lists reactions associated with a specific memo. Use `pageSize` to limit the number of results and `pageToken` to retrieve subsequent pages.
Adds or updates the authenticated user's reaction on a memo. Supply the memo resource name and the reaction with its `reactionType`; the operation upserts the authenticated user's reaction.
Lists relations associated with a specific memo. Use `pageSize` to limit the number of results and `pageToken` to retrieve subsequent pages.

Replaces the full set of mutable REFERENCE relations on a memo. Pass the complete desired list in `relations`; an empty list clears REFERENCE relations, while COMMENT relations remain unchanged and cannot be set through this operation.
Lists comments associated with a specific memo. Use `pageSize` and `pageToken` to control pagination, and `orderBy` to specify the result sort order.

Creates an independent memo with an immutable COMMENT relation to the specified memo. Supply `state`, `content`, and `visibility`; the new memo retains its own placement, visibility, authorship, and lifecycle.
Lists the members of a space. Use `pageSize` to limit the number of members returned and `pageToken` to continue from a previous response.

Lists settings for a user. Use `pageSize` to limit the number of settings returned and `pageToken` to continue from a previous page. The service returns at most 50 settings by default and coerces `pageSize` values above 1000 to 1000.
Lists the webhooks owned by a user. Use the `user` path parameter to select whose webhooks to retrieve; the results include webhook configuration and whether a signing secret is set.

Creates a webhook for a user. Provide the destination `url` and, if needed, a `signingSecret` for HMAC-SHA256 signing; the secret is not included in the response. The `name` field uses the `users/{user}/webhooks/{webhook}` resource-name format.
Lists share links that grant read-only access to a memo through opaque bearer tokens. The authenticated user must be the memo creator or an instance administrator.

Creates a share link that grants read-only access to a memo through an opaque bearer token. The authenticated user must be the memo creator or an instance administrator; set `expireTime` to limit how long the link works.
Retrieves the memo associated with a share token without requiring authentication. Use the opaque `shareToken` from the share URL; the token must be valid and unexpired to resolve the memo.

Lists a user's saved memo views, each of which stores a reusable CEL filter. Use a view's `filter` value as the `filter` argument when listing memos. The list contains the saved views for the specified user.

Creates a saved memo view for a user. Provide the required `title` and CEL `filter` expression; you can optionally provide a display `icon`. Set `validateOnly` to validate the request without creating the view.
Retrieves a setting for the specified instance. Use the `instance` identifier to select the instance and request the setting by its resource name, formatted as `instance/settings/{setting}`.

Updates configuration for an instance setting. Supply the setting resource in the request body and use `updateMask` to specify which fields to update; `storageType` and `accessMode` accept only their documented enum values.
Retrieves the signing secret for a user's webhook through an explicit, owner-gated call. Use this operation when you need the secret; it is not included in webhook list, create, or update responses.
Declines a pending invitation to join a space. Supply the invitation resource name in `name` to identify the invitation being declined.
Deletes a personal access token. Provide the user and token identifiers to specify which PAT to delete. The token is a long-lived credential for API or script access.
Accepts a pending invitation to join a space and creates a membership for the invitee. Supply the invitation resource name in `name`; the returned membership includes the user's role in the space.
Deletes a linked SSO identity from a user account. Supply the user and linked identity identifiers for the identity you want to unlink.
Retrieves a linked SSO identity for a user. Supply both resource identifiers to retrieve the identity associated with that user account.
Deletes a notification from a user's notification list. Supply the user and notification identifiers for the notification you want to delete.
Updates a user's notification. Use `updateMask` to select the fields to change; the request body schema exposes `status` as an editable field, while the other defined fields are read-only.
Deletes a pending invitation to join a space, revoking the invitation. Identify the space and invitation so you remove the intended invitation.
Retrieves a pending invitation to join a space. Use `space` and `invitation` to identify the invitation whose details you need, including its invitee and assigned role.
Deletes a reaction from a memo. Supply both the memo identifier and the reaction identifier to select the reaction to remove.
Deletes a membership from a space, removing the member. A member can delete their own membership to leave the space.
Retrieves one membership in a space. Use `space` and `member` to identify the space membership whose user and role you need.
Updates a member's role in a space. Supply the member resource in the body and use `updateMask` to select the supported `role` field for the update.
Retrieves a specific setting for a user. Provide the user ID and setting key to identify the setting resource. The setting key appears in the resource name as `users/{user}/settings/{setting}`.
Updates a user's setting. Supply the setting fields to change and use `updateMask` to specify which fields to update. The setting resource name follows the format `users/{user}/settings/{setting}`.
Deletes a webhook owned by a user. Identify the owner and the webhook to remove with the `user` and `webhook` path parameters.

Updates an existing webhook for a user. Use `updateMask` to identify the fields to change, and provide a `signingSecret` when you need to set or change the secret used to sign webhook requests. The `name` field uses the `users/{user}/webhooks/{webhook}` resource-name format.
Deletes a share link and revokes its read-only access to a memo. The authenticated user must be the memo creator or an instance administrator, and the share must belong to the specified memo.
Deletes a saved memo view for a user. Identify the user and the view to remove with the `user` and `view` path parameters.
Retrieves a saved memo view by name. Provide the user ID and view ID to identify the view. The response includes the saved view's CEL filter, which you can pass to the ListMemos `filter` argument.

Updates a saved memo view for a user. Supply `title` and `filter`; `filter` uses the CEL grammar accepted by ListMemos, and `updateMask` limits which fields change. Include `icon` in the update mask and omit its value to reset the view icon to the default.
Deletes multiple attachments in one request. Provide their resource names in the required `names` array. The operation removes each attachment identified in that array.

Uploads a file in chunks to create an attachment. Start an upload with `spec`, then use the returned `uploadId` to continue; each write must use the current committed byte offset. Uploads are bound to the authenticated user, expire after 30 minutes of inactivity, and do not survive a server restart.

Lists the identity providers configured for the instance. Use this operation to retrieve provider types, display titles, identifier filters, and configuration details before choosing or managing an identity provider.

Creates an identity provider for the instance. Supply `type`, `title`, and `config`; use `identityProviderId` to choose the resource ID, or omit it to have one generated. The provider type must be `TYPE_UNSPECIFIED` or `OAUTH2`.
Lists active users matching the supplied usernames. Provide `usernames` as an array of strings to identify the users to look up. The response contains the matching user records.
Transcribes an audio file using the instance's configured AI provider. Supply the required `audio` object with the audio input. The response contains the transcribed text.

Lists attachments linked to readable memos and unlinked uploads belonging to the authenticated user. Use `filter` to narrow the results and `orderBy` to sort them; use `pageToken` to retrieve subsequent pages.

Creates a new attachment. Supply the required `filename` and `type`, and optionally associate the attachment with a memo using `memo`. Set `attachmentId` to choose an ID, or omit it to have one generated.
Lists statistics for users, optionally scoped by memo state and filtered using the `ListMemos` filter syntax. `state` defaults to `NORMAL` and accepts `STATE_UNSPECIFIED`, `NORMAL`, or `ARCHIVED`.
Lists spaces that the authenticated user is a member of. Use `pageSize` to limit the number of results and `pageToken` to continue from a previous response.

Creates a space and makes the authenticated user its first administrator. Provide a `title` for the space, and optionally supply `spaceId` to choose its identifier; an empty or omitted `spaceId` generates a canonical UUID v4.

Lists readable, non-comment memos, with support for pagination, filtering, and sorting. Use `filter` to select memos and `orderBy` to control their order; `pageToken` continues a listing from a previous response.
Creates a memo owned by the authenticated user. Supply `content` in Markdown and choose a `visibility`; visibility defaults to PRIVATE when omitted. You must authenticate to create a memo.

Lists users on the instance, with optional filtering and inclusion of deleted users. Use `pageToken` to continue through results; `pageSize` defaults to at most 50 and values above 1000 are coerced to 1000.

Creates a user with a username, role, and state, along with any optional profile details. Set `validateOnly` to validate the request without creating the user, or pass `requestId` to make repeated creation requests idempotent.

Deletes an identity provider from the instance. Supply the identity provider's ID to select the resource to remove. Use this operation when the provider should no longer be available for authentication.
Retrieves a configured identity provider by its ID. Use the identity provider's identifier to get its resource name, type, display title, identifier filter, and configuration.

Updates an identity provider using the supplied resource fields and update mask. Include `type`, `title`, and `config` in the request body, and use `updateMask` to select the top-level fields to update. Only top-level fields of the identity provider are supported by the mask.

Exports the authenticated user's memos as a ZIP archive, including comments, archived memos, and attachment files. The `user` path parameter must identify the authenticated user; the response body is the archive, and its media type is provided as `content_type`.

Imports a Memos export archive into a user's memos through bounded chunk uploads. Start with `spec`, then use the returned `uploadId` for subsequent chunks; a finishing call can validate the archive without importing it or import it and return a report. Uploads are bound to the authenticated user and expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.

Retrieves statistics for a specific user, including memo counts, tag counts, memo timestamps, and pinned memos. Use `filter` to select readable non-comment memos using a CEL expression compatible with ListMemos.
Deletes an attachment by its identifier. Use the `attachment` path value to select the attachment to remove.
Retrieves an attachment by its identifier. Use the `attachment` path value to select the attachment you want to retrieve.
Updates an attachment identified by its resource name. Supply the attachment fields and use `updateMask` to specify which fields to update. The request body schema requires `filename` and `type`.
Deletes a space and every memo currently placed in it. This permanently removes those memos; deletion does not follow memo relations to other memos.
Retrieves a space that the authenticated user is a member of. Supply the space identifier to view its title, description, membership information, and other available metadata.
Updates metadata for a space. Use `updateMask` to select `title` or `description`, and provide `title` as required by the request schema.
Deletes the named memo and its owned resources without deleting other memos. Use `force` to delete the memo even when it has associated data; incident relations are removed.
Retrieves a memo by its identifier. Use the `memo` path parameter to specify which memo to retrieve.
Updates a memo with the fields supplied in the request body. Use `updateMask` to identify the fields to update; `state`, `content`, and `visibility` are required by the request schema.
Deletes a user. Set `force` to true to delete the user even when associated data exists; otherwise, the user is deleted without that override.
Retrieves a user by username. Use the `user` resource name in the format `users/{user}`; specify `readMask` to limit the fields in the response, or omit it to receive all fields.
Updates a user's fields using a partial update. Supply the user resource name and an `updateMask` to select the fields being updated; the request body schema requires `role`, `username`, and `state`.
